intro: Everyone runs the same course at the same time, on one screen: down a city street through the night traffic, or over the rooftops. Vault the parked cars, dodge the lorries, mind the red lights, and keep ahead of the security drone (and the police).
inspiredBy: Endless runner games have been around since the early 2000s; the three-lane kind became popular on phones in the 2010s. City Runners is our own take, made for running together.
goal: Be the last runner still going. On your own, run as far as you can: your best distance is saved.
howToPlay: Join with your phone. In the lobby, choose the route (Downtown Streets, Rooftops, The Rail Line or Sky Bridges) and how many computer runners to race, then press {bolt}.
Pick your runner with ◀ ▶. Each is good at something: changing lanes, jumping, shrugging off a stumble, or reaching for coins. Press {bolt} when you're happy.
Everyone runs on their own; it gets faster the longer you last.
Tap ◀ and ▶ to change lanes, ▲ (or {bolt}) to jump and ▼ (or {drop}) to slide. Slide in the air to drop straight down.
Jump barriers and gaps between the roofs. Slide under signs and pipes. Go round vent stacks, and don't run into the front of a train. A ramp takes you up onto a train's roof.
Downtown Streets: jump onto a parked car's roof and run over it (run into its back and you stumble). Vans, lorries and buses are too tall: go round them. Cars coming the other way will knock you out.

At each junction the lights are red or green for you. Cross on red and the police come after you; cross on red again, or stumble, while they're on you and you're busted. Cars cross the junction while it's red. The footbridge in one lane always gets you over safely: run up its ramp.
Some gaps are too wide to jump: cross on the steel beam, or jump up and grab the zip line.

At a crossing, each lane has its own way across (the signs, and your phone, say which): the zip line is the fastest, but you have to jump to grab it. The thin rail can't be missed, but you walk it slowly and fall behind; don't step off it. The ropes are a little quicker than running: jump onto the first, then press ▲ late in each swing to fly to the next. Too early, or not at all, and you fall.
Trip over a barrier or bump into something from the side and you stumble: the drone comes after you. Stumble again before it leaves and it has you. Fall too far behind the leader and it has you too.
Coins are first come, first served. Power-ups: magnet (pulls coins in), jump boots (jump much higher), shield (saves you once) and double (twice the score).
steering: Tap left and right to change lanes, up to jump, down to slide
tips: Change lanes early: you can't go through two vent stacks at once.
Run along the trains' roofs: it's safer up there, and that's where the coins are.
With the jump boots you can jump straight onto a train.
New to it? Tunde forgives mistakes. Want coins? Ava reaches into the next lane.
A shield also saves you from a fall: it throws you back up.
Watch the lights ahead: if they'll be red by the time you get there, head for the footbridge's lane early.
Car roofs are where the coins are on the streets, and they're safe from the traffic.
